label: John 2:1
text: The third day, there was a marriage in Cana of Galilee. Jesus’ mother was there.

label: John 2:2
text: Jesus also was invited, with his disciples, to the marriage.

label: John 2:3
text: When the wine ran out, Jesus’ mother said to him, “They have no wine.”

variants.reading: οινον ουκ ειχον οτι συνετελεσθη ο οινος του γαμου, ειτα (they did not have wine because the wine of the wedding reception was finished, then)
variants.note: Sinaiticus original hand (א*), with Old Latin manuscripts and the Syriac hmg; the rest read υστερησαντος οινου (they were running short of wine). Per the fetched Textual variants in the Gospel of John article.

label: John 2:6
text: Now there were six water pots of stone set there after the Jews’ way of purifying, containing two or three metretes apiece.

label: John 2:11
text: This beginning of his signs Jesus did in Cana of Galilee, and revealed his glory; and his disciples believed in him.

label: John 2:12
text: After this, he went down to Capernaum, he, and his mother, his brothers, and his disciples; and they stayed there a few days.

label: John 2:13
text: The Passover of the Jews was at hand, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.

label: John 2:14
text: He found in the temple those who sold oxen, sheep, and doves, and the changers of money sitting.

label: John 2:15
text: He made a whip of cords, and threw all out of the temple, both the sheep and the oxen; and he poured out the changers’ money, and overthrew their tables.

label: John 2:16
text:
To those who sold the doves, he said,
“Take these things out of here! Don’t make my Father’s house a marketplace!”

label: John 2:17
text: His disciples remembered that it was written, “Zeal for your house will eat me up.”

label: John 2:19
text:
Jesus answered them,
“Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up.”

label: John 2:20
text: The Jews therefore said, “It took forty-six years to build this temple! Will you raise it up in three days?”

label: John 2:23
text: Now when he was in Jerusalem at the Passover, during the feast, many believed in his name, observing his signs which he did.

label: A wedding at Cana in Galilee was attended by Jesus, his mother and his disciples
statement: A wedding was held at Cana in Galilee which Jesus, his mother and his disciples attended.
note: Cana's location is disputed: Khirbet Qana (excavated Roman-period village), Kafr Kanna (the 8th-century and modern traditional site), Karm er-Ras and Reineh are the candidates named in the fetched Wikipedia Cana article. The claim records the setting, not the water-into-wine miracle.

label: Jesus turned water into wine at Cana, his first sign
statement: Jesus turned six jars of water into wine at Cana, which John calls the beginning of his signs.
note: Miracle claim, written and searched honestly per docs/calibration.md. Setting evidence (Khirbet Qana, the stone vessels) attests the setting and the objects, never the miracle itself.

label: Six stone water jars stood at the house for the Jews' purification
statement: Six stone water jars stood at the Cana house, set there for the Jews' rites of purification, each holding two or three metretes (about 75-115 liters).

label: Jesus went down to Capernaum with his family and disciples and stayed a few days
statement: After the wedding, Jesus went down to Capernaum with his mother, his brothers and his disciples, and stayed there a few days.

label: Jews went up to Jerusalem for the Passover, and Jesus went up at Passover time
statement: The Passover of the Jews was at hand and Jesus went up to Jerusalem, in keeping with the pilgrimage custom of going up to Jerusalem for Passover.

label: John places the temple cleansing at the start of the ministry, at the first Passover
statement: John places the temple cleansing at the beginning of Jesus' ministry, at a Passover in the late 20s CE (see the 46-years arithmetic), whereas the Synoptics place it in the final week before the crucifixion.
note: Chronology difference between Gospels; recorded with related_to against the Matthew 21 cleansing claims, never as attests or complicates (docs/calibration.md).

label: Oxen and sheep were sold in the temple precincts
statement: Oxen and sheep, as well as doves, were sold in the temple precincts for sacrifice (John's detail; the dove sellers and money changers are shared with Matthew 21:12 and are linked there).

label: Jesus said 'Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up'
statement: During the temple confrontation Jesus said 'Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up' (John explains he meant the temple of his body).
note: Prediction/saying: evidence can attest the saying's setting, never that the prediction was fulfilled (docs/calibration.md).

label: The temple's rebuilding had been going on for forty-six years
statement: As of the Passover of John 2, the Jews said the temple had been under construction for forty-six years.

label: Many believed in Jesus' name at the Passover feast in Jerusalem
statement: While Jesus was in Jerusalem at the Passover feast, many believed in his name, observing his signs.

text: His mother said to the servants, “Whatever he says to you, do it.”

text: He said to them, “Now draw some out, and take it to the ruler of the feast.” So they took it.

text: When the ruler of the feast tasted the water now become wine, and didn’t know where it came from (but the servants who had drawn the water knew), the ruler of the feast called the bridegroom,

label: John 2:10
text: and said to him, “Everyone serves the good wine first, and when the guests have drunk freely, then that which is worse. You have kept the good wine until now!”

label: John 2:18
text: The Jews therefore answered him, “What sign do you show us, seeing that you do these things?”

label: John 2:21
text: But he spoke of the temple of his body.

text: When therefore he was raised from the dead, his disciples remembered that he said this, and they believed the Scripture, and the word which Jesus had said.

label: John 2:24
text: But Jesus didn’t entrust himself to them, because he knew everyone,

label: John 2:25
